name: Hautes-Gorges-de-la-Rivière-Malbaie National Park
policyReason: Leashed dogs are allowed on five trails, part of one campground and a picnic area, but not on the shuttle.
summary: Leashed dogs are allowed on five trails, part of one campground and a picnic area, but not on the shuttle.

excerpts.quote: Les chiens sont admis dans le parc.
L'accès des chiens est cependant limité à certains endroits, selon certaines conditions.
Les chiens ne sont pas admis dans la navette.

dogRules.text: Trails (summer and winter): Le Riverain, Les Rapides, Le Pied-des-Sommets, L’Érablière, Le Lac-Sans-Oreille.
Camping Le Cran loop 8 (sites 107 to 123) and Camping L’Épervier (RV).
No dogs on the shuttle; when it runs, private cars are not allowed in the park.
No dogs on the Malbaie River above the Érables dam, or on climbing approach trails and cliffs.
